agent.response:
I used a subquery in the HAVING clause to compare each region's average against the overall average.

```sql
SELECT 
    region, 
    AVG(revenue) AS avg_region_revenue
FROM 
    sales
GROUP BY 
    region
HAVING 
    AVG(revenue) > (SELECT AVG(revenue) FROM sales);
```
